source: Roboflow rfdetr package (github.com/roboflow/rf-detr), official COCO checkpoint downloaded by RFDETRNano() from HuggingFace (roboflow org)
export: model.export(format='onnx') with Roboflow's rfdetr ONNX exporter (opset 17, fp32), then onnxruntime.quantization.quantize_dynamic (MatMul/Gemm/Attention weights to int8; Conv layers stay fp32). rfdetr's export() quantization parameter is TFLite-only and ignored for ONNX; the fp32 export (~115 MB) exceeds GitHub's 100 MB file limit, so dynamic quantization is what makes the file committable.
quantization: dynamic int8 (onnxruntime.quantization.quantize_dynamic, onnxruntime 1.31.0); weights int8, activations fp32
license: Apache 2.0 (RF-DETR-N is Apache 2.0 per roboflow/rf-detr README benchmarks)
class_layout: logits (Q, 91); slot index = COCO category ID (sparse 1-90); official COCO weights: final slot is the real class 90, not background; decode keeps every slot, unmapped slots never emit
decode: per-class sigmoid, top-Q pairs, score > 0.3, no NMS; preprocess: direct resize, /255, ImageNet mean/std, NCHW

verification.parity: same top-5 label set, scores within 0.1
